map.农机具作业效率对比器 使用指南: Farm Machinery Work Efficiency Comparator User Guide
map.农机作业效率对比器，计算并对比多台农机亩/小时效率、油耗与经济性，辅助农机选型与: A farm machinery work efficiency comparator that computes and compares mu-per-hour efficiency, fuel use and economics across machines, supporting machine selection and job scheduling.
map.理论生产率 = 幅宽(m) × 速度(km/h) × 0.15 (亩/h)；实际: Theoretical productivity = width (m) × speed (km/h) × 0.15 (mu/h); actual productivity = theoretical × time utilization %; work hours = total area ÷ actual productivity; cost per mu = (fuel cost + labor cost) ÷ total area
map.经验换算：幅宽 1 m、速度 1 km/h 约合 0.15 亩/h（由 1 km: Rule of thumb: a width of 1 m at a speed of 1 km/h is about 0.15 mu/h (from 1 km × 1 m = 1000 m² ≈ 1.5 mu, times the 0.001 h factor). Theoretical productivity times time utilization gives actual productivity, then work hours follow from total area; fuel is hourly consumption × work hours × fuel price and labor is work hours × hourly wage, both converted to cost per unit area for cross-comparison and selection of machines.
map.折算亩油耗、亩成本横向对比机型。: Convert to fuel per mu and cost per mu to compare machine models.
map.用于购机选型与外包作业比价。: For comparing machine purchases and outsourcing work.

A is more efficient but costs more fuel; combined cost per mu is 18 CNY for A vs 17 CNY for B, and you need to see whether workload spreads the fixed cost.

map.为什么同一机不同地块效率差？: Why does the same machine perform differently on different plots?
map.地块规整度、作物倒伏、土壤湿度、转弯掉头次数都影响。对比应在同类条件下，或取多地: Plot regularity, crop lodging, soil moisture and the number of turns all matter. Compare under similar conditions, or average across several plots.
